documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Notice Of Shareholders Meeting - Extra Ordinary General Meeting Schedule To Be Held On December 16, 2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Code of Conduct under SEBI (PIT) Regulations, 2015

analysis.summary: Management reported strong consolidated financial results for H1 FY27, with revenue growing by approximately 39% and EBITDA increasing by 48%. Growth was primarily driven by core products and the materialization of customer developments into regular business, rather than forward integration. Management discussed plans for capacity enhancement, ongoing inventory cycle management, and potential expansion into specialized materials for electronic applications. Management reported steady financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, highlighted by consolidated revenue growth, expanding gross and EBITDA margins, and robust demand across shunt resistors and thermostatic bimetals. The company continues to advance its forward integration initiatives, notably through the Pune facility for PCBA and busbar assemblies, while expanding its global and domestic customer footprint.

guidance.claim: Management expects overall revenue growth for FY27 to be between 20% and 30%.
guidance.quote: Anyway, so… so growth, you know, we… if things go as per what we have in, in forecast, etc, or what expectations we have from the customers, we could… we could, on an overall revenue basis be looking at somewhere… somewhere between the, you know, that 20% to 30% kind of a number.

guidance.claim: The company expects standalone revenue split to be roughly 44-45% from bimetals and 54-55% from shunts.
guidance.quote: So now, coming to the expectation of what we, or what we are seeing from our customers and what forecasts we have, we expect that on a Shivalik standalone basis, we expect, like, maybe a 44-45% revenue coming from Bimetal, and 54-55% coming from shunts.

guidance.claim: Consolidated revenue contribution from the contacts business is expected to be between 30% and 35%.
guidance.quote: On a consolidated level, I think we would be more like, maybe around, you know, like a 30-35% of total consolidated revenue would be from, somewhere between the 30% to 35% should be from the contacts business, which is the wholly owned subsidiary.

guidance.claim: The company expects about 15-16% of total revenue in the first year to come from PCBA assemblies and bus bar assemblies.
guidance.quote: And, we expect that, from… from the… these assemblies, the PCB assemblies and these, bus bar assemblies, we expect, like, maybe a… about a… in the first year, maybe about a 15-16% of total revenue coming from that.

demand_outlook.claim: The outlook for medium and low voltage switchgear in India generally looks good for the next two or three quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: what, at least what information, what we have from our customers, as well as whatever research we do, that the outlook generally in India now for the next two or three quarters for medium and low voltage, switchgear is looking good.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that Q2 FY27 continued the momentum with a recovery in shunts in the domestic market and the rest of Asia.
demand_outlook.quote: Q2 FY27 continues the strong momentum set by the first quarter, with recovery in Shunts in the Domestic Market (27% YoY) and the rest of Asia (94% YoY).

demand_outlook.claim: India delivered broad-based growth across both bimetals and shunts businesses.
demand_outlook.quote: India delivered broad-brace growth across both businesses.

demand_outlook.claim: Europe grew strongly led by shunts, while the Americas showed early improvement in shunts with a 30% year-on-year growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Europe grew strongly, led by shunts, with the Americas also showing early improvement in shunts with a 30% growth year-on-year this quarter, after a softer FY26.

demand_outlook.claim: Asia was weaker during the quarter and remains an area of focus for rebuilding momentum.
demand_outlook.quote: Asia was weaker during the quarter, and remains an area where we are focused on building rebuild… on rebuilding momentum.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is seeing an uptake in bimetal quantities for the domestic market, driven by real estate and infrastructure development.
demand_outlook.quote: For the first time in, actually, quite a few quarters now, like, 4 or 5 quarters, we are actually getting this kind of a feedback from the customers, wherein… and we are actually seeing it in this current quarter, that Bimetal is, for the first time, seeing an uptake in terms of not value or anything, but specifically in terms of quantities.

capex_expansion.claim: Core focus for capex moving forward will be on capacity enhancement on downstream processes and automation.
capex_expansion.quote: core focus moving forward will be, A) in capacity enhancement on downstream processes, because as we've discussed in the past also, you know, the core, if you talk about the core product categories where it comes to the actual diffusion or the… or the merging of the metals, for either of the business verticals, that principal processes have sufficient capacity, but as and when required, depending on the demand from the market or the order book, there is enhancement that has to happen on the downstream processes, which is a fairly quick cycle to enhance.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is establishing a Pune facility to strengthen its presence in PCBA and busbar assemblies for automotive and electrification-led applications.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our growth strategy, we are establishing our Pune facility to strengthen our presence in PCBA and busbar assemblies for automotive and electrification-led applications.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase I of the Pune facility holds Consent to Operate valid until June 30, 2032.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase I holds Consent to Operate from the Maharashtra Pollution Control Board, valid until June 30, 2032.

capex_expansion.claim: Receiving consent to operate for Phase 1 is an important milestone in the operationalization of the Pune facility.
capex_expansion.quote: Subsequent to the quarter, receiving consent to operate for Phase 1 is an important milestone in the operationalization of our Pune facility.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex requirement for the entire Pune bus bar and cell connecting systems project is in the ballpark of 20 to 25 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So, the CAPEX requirement for this entire project is somewhere in the, you know, ballpark of about 20 to 25 crores.

margins_costs.claim: A vast majority of materials are sort of a pass-through, so any increase or decrease in commodity prices has minimal impact on the bottom line.
margins_costs.quote: our pricing works in such a way that we… in most cases, or a vast majority of materials are sort of a pass-through, so any increase or decrease has very minimal impact on our bottom line.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone gross margin expanded by 438 basis points in Q2 FY27 driven by product mix and disciplined input cost management.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin expanded by 438 basis points to 54.20% in Q2 FY27, driven by a richer product mix and disciplined input cost management.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin improved by 605 basis points to 29.85% in Q2 FY27 on a standalone basis.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 53.46% year-on-year to ₹43.26 crore in Q2 FY26-27, with the EBITDA Margin improving by 605 basis points to 29.85%.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue grew 33.4% year-on-year to 182.2 crores, EBITDA increased 35.2% to 43.2 crores, and PAT grew 44.9% to 33 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Consolidated revenue grew 33.4% year-on-year to 182.2 crores, EBITDA increased 35.2 to 43.2 crores, and PAT grew 44.9% to 33 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Sequentially, revenue increased 13%, EBITDA 23%, and PAT 26%.
margins_costs.quote: Sequentially, revenue increased 13%, EBITDA 23%, and PAT 26%, giving us a strong operating start to FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Margin improvement was achieved while employee costs increased as the company invested in capacity, people, and capability.
margins_costs.quote: Importantly, this margin improvement was achieved while employee costs increased as we invested in capacity, people, and capability, giving us confidence that the underlying operating model is strengthening as we scale.

margins_costs.claim: About half of the year-on-year revenue growth can be attributed purely to silver pricing.
margins_costs.quote: So I would say about what you purely see as revenue, about half of that revenue growth can be attributed to silver, silver, alone.

orders_capacity.claim: By the end of this year, the contacts business is expected to be at around 55% capacity utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: So, by the end of this year, we should be probably be at around you know, 55% capacity utilization, to answer your question.

orders_capacity.claim: Shunts remained the stronger growth engine with revenue increasing 18.7%, while bimetals grew 7.4%.
orders_capacity.quote: From the quarter, Shunts remained the stronger growth engine, with revenue increasing 18.7%, but bimetals grew 7.4%.

orders_capacity.claim: Welding capacity utilization for shunts is currently at about 65% to 70%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, if we look at purely our welding capacity, right now we are at about 65%-70% of our welding capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: Management priorities for the year remain margin quality, working capital efficiency, cash conversion, and selective capital allocation.
capital_allocation.quote: Looking ahead, Q1 positions us well for a positive year. Our priorities remain margin quality, working capital efficiency, cash conversion, and selective capital allocation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Inventory buildup is partly driven by supply chain cycles shifting and requiring multiple validation cycles for finished components and assemblies.
risks_headwinds.quote: in those cases, the, you know, the supply chain cycles have slightly shifted, which are still stabilizing, where certain programs require multiple validation cycles, and, you know, there's quick reaction in terms of design changes.

risks_headwinds.claim: Asia was weaker during the quarter and remains an area where management is focused on rebuilding momentum.
risks_headwinds.quote: Asia was weaker during the quarter, and remains an area where we are focused on building rebuild… on rebuilding momentum.

management_commitments.claim: A new CFO is finalized and should be with the company by the end of December.
management_commitments.quote: a new CFO should be, with us, and, you know, it's all finalized, should be with us, and, by the end of December.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
